description: This file defines and exports various API endpoint functions for network operations in a web application, including authentication, notes, folders, tags, collaboration, preferences, notifications, and sharing features.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with provided email and password data.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, and name.

methods.name: oauthStart
methods.description: Initiates OAuth login with specified provider.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Fetches list of notes with optional parameters.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note by ID.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by ID.

methods.name: inviteCollaborator
methods.description: Invites a collaborator to a note.

methods.name: removeCollaborator
methods.description: Removes a collaborator from a note.

methods.name: getCollaborators
methods.description: Retrieves list of collaborators for a note.

methods.name: exportNote
methods.description: Exports a note in specified format.

methods.name: shareNote
methods.description: Shares a note with specified user.
